description: Checks a restaurant's own website as the online check on restaurantdoctorai.com does: secure (https) and on its own address, made for phones, a menu written as text that phones and Google can read, online orders on its own terms or only through delivery apps, the address, hours and phone written on the page, tap to call, a way to get in touch, email sign-up and gift cards, what Google reads (a headline, title and description, not hidden from search, restaurant structured data), the preview a shared link shows, the page's text, story, questions, reviews, photo descriptions and social links, and Google's phone speed test with its measures one by one and real visitors' speed when Google has it (15 to 40 seconds; phoneSpeed: false skips it). Returns each check with what to fix, the three to fix first, and a link to the full online check, which adds the Google listing and places nearby, free on the website. A check it couldn't make (a page drawn by scripts, a security screen instead of the page) is marked "Couldn't check" and left out of the score, never failed; every check, its points and where its facts come from are listed at https://restaurantdoctorai.com/online-check/checks. Takes only the website address. The website isn't stored; only an anonymous daily count of checks is kept.

phoneSpeed.description: Whether to run Google's phone speed test too (the default). It takes 15 to 40 seconds; false skips it.

website.description: The restaurant's own website address, such as joesdiner.com or https://www.joesdiner.com. Not a DoorDash, Uber Eats or Google Maps page.

name: restaurantdoctor_check_website

anyOf.description: What to do, for a check that needs work.

status.description: pass, warn (could be better), fail (needs fixing) or unknown (couldn't check).

fixFirst.description: Up to three checks to fix first, most important first.

fullCheckUrl.description: The full online check on restaurantdoctorai.com: adds the Google listing and the places nearby, free.

ordersOnlyThroughApps.description: The site links online orders only to delivery apps (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub…), which charge a commission on each.

phoneSpeedSkipped.description: Google's phone speed test wasn't run, because phoneSpeed was false. It isn't in the score.

score.description: 0 to 100, from the website and phone-speed checks only (the full check adds the Google listing).

website.description: Where the site answered after redirects: its scheme and host only, such as https://www.joesdiner.com.

title: Check a restaurant's website
